manual_lowering_choices: Arm64 path is selected; no claim about automatic preprocessing validation.
Loop counters and input byte offset use Nat at the logical value layer.
NEON fixed decreasing loops become primitive recursion on input.length/2048, 128, and remaining batch/16; no arbitrary bounded-fuel cutoff.
Constant 32-byte mask table and tail pointer expression are normalized to batch ones plus 16-batch zeros; multiplication stays BV8.
Source block-local vacc16_0 and vacc16 share one explicit typed vacc16 state field, reset at exactly the corresponding block entry.
BV16 and BV32 registers remain distinct; only proof-side ghost observations can identify their sums.
Old output is carried unchanged through the loop; params is unused, and null pointers are represented only by valid logical streams/scalar output.
RVV machine vsetvl policy is replaced by a supplied complete positive bounded schedule; proving over this larger value domain does not establish a CSR implementation bridge.
Final reduction seed/lane-0 extraction is normalized to a scalar fold over exactly vlmax accumulator lanes.
All needed arithmetic wrappers are local manual semantics, not canonical registry approvals.

proof_domain.overread: arbitrary List (BitVec 8) with at least 15 readable logical bytes
proof_domain.schedule: any positive width and complete list of positive chunks, each no greater than width

not_established: ISA intrinsic refinement or compiler/binary correctness
Production elementwise registry, artifact gate, or publisher integration
Generality to floating-point reductions or all 40 kernels
